facts: the front door closes behind Armand
rainwater darkens the floor beneath his boots

narration: You cross the threshold, and the front door settles shut behind you. Rainwater shines beneath your boots while the unlit chandelier hangs over the narrow stair, every crystal black in the gloom.

facts: fresh scratches surround the locked drawer

narration: You trace the edge of the locked drawer. Fresh scratches score the wood around its keyhole; whatever marked it did so recently, but the drawer remains closed.
You wrench the cabinet open. Its hinge snaps with a pistol-crack, and the footsteps beyond the corridor door stop at once.

facts: loose glass falls onto the floor

narration: You press the latch; it gives before the window does. A sliver of loose glass drops and breaks on the floor, bright and sharp in the silence, while the window stays shut.

facts: Guillermo hears a faint scratching behind the wall
packet.guillermo_stage_direction: He freezes, presses one ear to the wallpaper, then gives Armand a long look and points at the wall. He does not speak.

narration: You see Guillermo freeze beside the faded settee. He presses one small ear to the floral paper, listens to the faint scratching beyond it, then turns a long, accusing look on you and points at the wall.

facts: only dust, a loose button, and a dead beetle are present

narration: You search beneath the coat rack. Dust softens the boards around a loose button and the husk of a beetle; nothing else waits there.

packet.target: station clerk about the abandoned case
facts: Armand asks who left the case
npc_disclosure: the clerk says a woman in a grey veil left it before midnight
the clerk refuses to describe her face
the clerk does not disclose anything else

narration: You ask who left the case. The clerk glances from it to the brass clock. ‘A woman in a grey veil, before midnight.’ When you press him for her face, his mouth hardens. ‘That is all I can tell you.’

facts: the desk drawer was closed on the previous visit
the desk drawer is now open
the papers previously on the desk are gone
recent_history: Armand previously left the study with its drawer closed and papers on the desk

narration: You return to the study and find the desk altered. The drawer you left closed now gapes open, and the papers are gone from the bare desktop; only the extinguished fireplace remains as you remember it.
